summary: Gilpin County, CO 40-foot steel tower built 1941 on Starr Peak; sources give 1976 or 1996 for removal; a rooftop antenna structure stood there in 2010.

facts.status_note: Tower taken down; sources disagree on the year (1976 or 1996); a rooftop antenna structure stood on the site as of May 2010

access.note: As of May 2010 there was no public trailhead at either end of the Boiling Gulch Trail, and land at the trail ends was private (SummitPost)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS register and SummitPost (which cites the NHLR) give 1996; the 2009 Daily Camera column gives 1976. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

The FFLOS coordinates appear to sit northwest of the Sheepshead point, which SummitPost places southeast of Starr Peak, which fits the tower standing on Starr Peak as the Daily Camera describes. The other coordinates in the brief are not tied to a page read for this story.

notes_for_editor: Removal year conflicts (1976 vs 1996) and the story reports both. The tower stood on Starr Peak per SummitPost and the Daily Camera, while the FFLOS record is named for the mountain. The weebly page gives a second pair of coordinates that the brief uses; no coordinates were read on that page. FFLOS also cites a Denver Post photo of about 1966 or 1967 by David Mathias, but no image URL was read, so no photo was added. The rooftop antenna is a 2010 observation; current condition is not described.
